svg.text: NEMA17 / Motor with integrated USB controller
MOUNTING REFERENCE • v1.0.58 • COVER R2 / TRAY R1 • mm
4 × M3 on a 31 × 31 square, centered on shaft
Ø22 pilot × 2 high / Ø5 shaft × 23.5 projection
USB-C DATA and PWR on one edge, 13 apart
50.3 face to lid / 73.8 shaft tip to lid
Reference motor: 17HE15-1504S from the packing model. Confirm the fitted motor before machining.
Rigid envelope excludes label thickness, flexible motor lead, and inserted USB plugs. Nominal dimensions.
